assumptions: This is the retained 2025-2029 example with supplied 2024 field crop/grass-age states, not an observed future-weather forecast.
Archived weather ends at 2024-01-01. All years after 2023, including the 2024 bridge, use explicit historical climate analogues.
Missing leap dates are interpolated from February 28 and March 1. Other dates match by month and day, not day-of-year index.
Future crop calendars and profiles are copied from the latest compatible calibrated occurrence on the same field, or another calibrated field if unavailable locally.
The original planner used historical crop counts as tie-breakers. This scenario explicitly requires its annual/horizon ranges as hard field-count constraints.
The search can use any matrix transition with score at least 0.5 and retains compulsory perennial stand continuation.
Potato and the separate legume-cereal-mixture state are excluded until matching calibrated APSIM components and management are supplied.
Economics use inherited diagnostic prices; only harvested Wheat/Oats grain has a supplied sale price.
The end of the modeled horizon retains native RotationManager terminal behavior; no unobserved 2030 planting is invented.
Harvested dry matter is native AquaCrop, with no additive APSIM yield correction. Soil indicators are APSIM outputs on the identical candidate map and weather.
AquaCrop starts at the 2024 bridge with layered volumetric water from APSIM on 2023-12-31. Effective perennial biomass/reserves are approximations, not transferred states.
AquaCrop effective crop profiles remain uncalibrated; APSIM crop calibration is not an AquaCrop calibration. AquaCrop biomass is not fed back to APSIM soil C/N.
Fertilizer/depth/cultivar effects not represented by the supplied AquaCrop profiles are not invented. Fertilizer amounts affect diagnostic costs and APSIM soil calculations.
Humic is an optimization objective, not a feasibility constraint. Absolute stock losses remain reported for each field; a feasible crop map may lose soil carbon.
Joint search changes legal crop sequences and crop-level management policies. Starting management preset is only an anchor, not a fixed technology.
